summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, furnishing a press release and materials reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing notes routine operational updates including revenue growth, EBITDA, net profit, digital revenue expansion, and an upward revision of 2026 outlook. Additionally, it mentions the acquisition of internet service provider Shtorm and the consolidation of Tabletki.ua, but these are described as ordinary strategic developments within the earnings release, not standalone special situation transactions requiring separate classification. The filing does not announce any special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, capital return, or activist campaign. The content is a standard quarterly earnings update with no structural corporate action that fits the specified special-situation categories.
